items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-11-10
items.q: I knew the Duke Ellington band, I knew every guy in the band, because we worked together in New York.

ctx.x: Well, I can remember that, sure, up into the 60s or so, not a problem with anybody who tried to do that. Well, the funniest thing

that ever happened in my life, I'm glad to know that it was 11.30 or 12 o'clock at night. When Duke Ellington, I knew the Duke Ellington band, I knew every guy in the band, because we worked together in New York. I mean, they were upstairs, we were downstairs, we were not in the same band, but every intermission we were together, and Sonny Greer was a dear friend of mine, the drummer, and Roy Eldridge, I knew Roy very well, and they came down here and they played, that's when I first came home, about 1941 or 42,…

items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: We had Duke Ellington uniforms, almost.

ctx.x: Here's the blue room there, with Gordon Kirst playing, leading. This is a... Oh, wow. Oh, wow. Louie Macenthal was playing bass. Uh-huh. We had Duke Ellington uniforms, almost.
